name: hud_ui_panel_measure_text_prefix_rect
description: HudUiPanel::MeasureTextPrefixRect measures either a truncated text prefix or a reference glyph into a RECT using a compatible GDI DC.
known_limits: Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited by HLIL rendering the reference glyph pointer through the DWORD-aligned g_zInput_KeyCharRow_POIUYTREWQ data object instead of as the byte string "W".
tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiPanel source-cluster pass.
